versions.shortDescription: Trainable scikit-learn Logistic Regression baseline with built-in explainability.
versions.longDescription:
# LogisticRegression

LogisticRegression is a trainable scikit-learn baseline classifier. It trains on a CSV containing numeric features and a target/label column, optionally standardizes numeric features, generates predictions (including per-class probabilities), exports a coefficient table (including intercepts), and produces a human-readable explainability report highlighting the most influential positive/negative coefficients per class.

## What this tool does
- Reads a training CSV (`data`) with a configurable `target_column` and optional first column `id`.
- Optionally standardizes numeric feature columns (recommended).
- Trains a scikit-learn Logistic Regression model with configurable solver/regularization.
- Outputs:
  - predictions (label + probability columns)
  - coefficients (long-form coefficients per class, incl. intercept)
  - explanation (HTML report of top positive/negative coefficients)
  - report (short textual summary)

## Configuration
### Hyperparameters
- `target_column`: name of the target column in the input CSV
- `standardize`: standardize numeric features before training
- `C`: inverse regularization strength
- `max_iter`: maximum iterations
- `solver`: optimization algorithm
- `multi_class`: multi-class strategy
- `class_weight`: class weighting strategy
- `random_state`: random seed
- `explain_top_k`: number of top coefficients to show per class

hyperparams.description: Name of the target/label column in the training CSV.

hyperparams.description: Standardize numeric features before training and prediction.

hyperparams.name: class_weight
hyperparams.description: Class weighting strategy. Use balanced for imbalanced datasets.

hyperparams.description: Number of top positive/negative coefficients per class to show in explanation.html.

input.description: Training CSV containing numeric features and a target column (target_column). Optional first column 'id'.
